maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from selling electricity from Merom power plant and coal mining; not repair or servicing of installed base.

publicly_funded.reason: Power sold into the MISO/PJM-type grid and capacity markets, paid by utilities and ultimately private ratepayers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is from operating Merom plant, Sunrise Coal and the Turtle Creek gas build; only occasional deals like the plant purchase.

mission_critical.reason: Provides always-on dispatchable power and capacity to grid; utility customers rely on it under contracts, so switching is disruptive.

notes: Power generation is now the larger part of the business, with Sunrise Coal as the other part.
